raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the source node's goal is the fast route's convergence and analytic-oracle accuracy on the limited and diverted certificate rows at 550 and 2000 cells, one poloidal panel per 550-cell row, and a fragment carrying the table and panels; the two commits read here (967bbd618 and aca068f62) serve it by making the limited 550-cell panel draw the route's own boundary point (scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/render_panel.py:155,181) and by making the boundary gate fail closed (scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/boundary_gap.py:139).
VERDICT done_when: the brief's done-when asks convergence, updates, fresh residual, axis/X-point/boundary ratios against the precision budget, the present route's status, the lattice X-point gap, the unpromoted flux gap, the asymptote difference and one panel per 550-cell row; the two commits change none of those measurements and their manifest records the same rows, so the gate that measures the done_when is the boundary --check run at boundary_gap.py:77, which exits 0 with CHECK=PASS over the two archived limited rows when I re-ran it at the reviewed head.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-route-rows.html and docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-route-rows; `git diff --name-only bb59f06a74af..aca068f62a5c` lists exactly those four files (two scripts, the fragment, limited-550.svg), all inside the declared roots, no product code and no test file.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the boundary --check command as one literal command naming results/gate-boundary-check.log, whose last lines are CHECK=PASS and EXIT=0, and it names the --state fail-closed and --check --output negative controls in its checkpoint and artifacts lines rather than in a log path.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from bb59f06a74af to aca068f62a5c — 967bbd618 replaces the local digest() with an import of nova.database.content_store.sha256_bytes, adds the --output write under --check (boundary_gap.py:109), makes --state exit nonzero on a failing row (boundary_gap.py:139), and draws the limited row's route contact as a filled diamond over the oracle square with a narrower white casing (render_panel.py:155,181,222); aca068f62 restates that convention in the limited-panel figcaption (bank-route-rows.html:200-210) without touching any measured number; total +120/-80 across four files.
CALL_SITES: scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/run.sh:11 is the only in-repository invoker (it runs whatever BANK_ROUTE_MODULE names, which is how scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/boundary_gap.py is reached); render_panel.py has no in-repository caller and is run as a module command; no runtime code under nova/ reaches either file.
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/render_panel.py:181 draws the limited row's own boundary point, which is the panel a limited 550-cell row owes, and boundary_gap.py:139 makes its gate refuse a failing row.
SCORE evidence: 15
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the manifest names results/gate-boundary-check.log, but that log's header line 1 says REVISION=bb59f06a74af (pre-change) while its --check --output JSON proves it ran the post-fix tree; I re-ran boundary_gap.py --check --output at aca068f62 and got CHECK=PASS with EXIT=0.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: `git diff --name-only bb59f06a74af..aca068f62a5c` returns only scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/boundary_gap.py, scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/render_panel.py, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-route-rows.html and docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-route-rows/limited-550.svg, all inside the declared write roots.
SCORE durability: 14
JUSTIFICATION durability: the guard at scripts/prototypes/bank_route_rows/boundary_gap.py:139 does fail closed — a scratch copy with BOUNDARY_BUDGET=1e-12 printed ALL_PASS=False and exited 1 — but nothing automated or logged exercises it, so removing the line would redden no test.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: render_panel.py:155 names route_marker by mechanism and reuses draw_nulls/draw_wall, boundary_gap.py:24 imports sha256_bytes, and a scan of the added lines for plan, ticket and version labels returned nothing.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the diff removes the duplicated digest() and imports nova/database/content_store.py sha256_bytes instead, and the added contact marker uses matplotlib directly because no owner draws a single boundary point (nova/media/poloidal.py:274 draw_boundary draws a closed flux surface, not a marker).
